readout_other: ultrasound evoked potentials recorded via implanted titanium head pins; visual choice (discrimination) task
direction_notes: Sonication evoked transient target-specific EEG potentials (strongest at the target 4 mm medial and 4 mm posterior to the assumed LGN). Sonication of the maximal-response targets shifted visual choice preference in one subject; control targets did not.
safety_notes: Heating was estimated from earlier MR thermometry as about 0.03 degC per 100-ms sonication; no safety outcomes were measured.

exposures.label: Remus phased array, 480 kHz, 24 targets around the left and right LGN (UEP parameters and behavioural parameters)

timing.protocol_description: Lists are [UEP experiment, behavioural experiment]. UEP: 100-ms sonications at 31 W/cm2 with random inter-sonication interval averaging 17 s, 60 sonications per target; behaviour: a single 30-s sonication per session after a 375-trial baseline.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Two male macaque monkeys (Macaca mulatta, subjects B and H, ages seven and six years, and weight 15.0 and 10.8 kg, respectively) participated in the study
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Ultrasound evoked potentials were measured across six sessions in subject B and eight sessions in subject H. The total number of trials delivered to each animal was the same (60 sonications per target)
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The transducer array has a center frequency of 650 kHz but was driven at 480 kHz for this study
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: The stimulation of the deep brain regions was achieved using Remus (Fig. 1a), a system for remote ultrasound delivery into the brain.<sup>2–4,24</sup> In Remus, a 256-element phased array transducer is affixed to the head of an awake and head-fixed nonhuman primate (NHP) subject
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: The UEP parameters have a shorter pulse duration than those in existing studies of ultrasound neuromodulation in humans, but a higher time average, spatial peak intensity (I ) across that 100- millisecond duration (15 W/cm<sup>2</sup>).
